scope: Generic public engineering control experiment, no patent-specific proposed algorithm
dataset: Frozen simulated satellite MVP only, all labels SIMULATED, 4 missions x 4 cycles
fixed_architecture: original MSF-MOFS-selected features -> frozen 2-level classifier -> frozen causal HMM -> anomaly probability fusion
feature_budget_note: OPS-SAT 2578D budget max 64 and actual37 fixed only for OPS-SAT; no retroactive change to frozen synthetic 400D state features (50 and 10 selected).

update.source: SIMULATED reviewed anomaly labels on entire windows in cycle8 only
update.gate: Existing public fail-closed label quality validator, demo override enabled, no real reviewer
update.anomaly_detector: Same RandomForest 120 trees, max_depth14, min_samples_leaf2, balanced_subsample, seed42, n_jobs2, refit original base training+one new-label batch
update.anomaly_threshold: both old and updated threshold selected on cycle9 only
update.fusion_fit: both old-compatible and refreshed fusion trained on same fixed cycle10 3-state SIMULATED labels; no gate/test labels in fit

scenario.natural: actual refit anomaly RF on base + simulated vetted cycle8 labels
scenario.logit_scale_stress: diagnostic artificial p'=sigmoid(1.8*logit(p)+0.7) applied to new RF output; represents hypothetical interface probability shift, NOT a trained model or real event

arms.A: old anomaly detector + old-compatible fusion fit on reserved cycle10
arms.B: updated anomaly detector + stale old fusion (same as A)
arms.C: updated anomaly detector + ordinary supervised fusion retrain on exactly cycle10, same state/HMM
arms.D: validation-only staged selection: accept C if ordinary frozen safety metrics, otherwise retain A; no real deployment

interpretation_policy: Same synthetic data; prior mission3 metrics already publicly inspected, so this is exploratory diagnostic not confirmatory test
Original MVP fusion fitted ALL mission2; avoid leakage by refitting both A and C only on cycle10 and using distinct cycle11 as gate
All labels are simulated, never claim new operator-verified physical spacecraft labels
Stress case is deterministic model-interface perturbation, NOT proof supervised update produces that drift
Fusion retrain uses normal logistic stacking, not a novel patent method
No self-learning, no automated production release
Do not change original release or main
No authentic physical three-state labels on real OPS-SAT; do not merge disparate datasets' label semantics
